aussen.anschlag.notiz: Attack with traces across the border
aussen.anschlag.text.is: Investigators find links to Syria. Tourism slumps, nationalists demand toughness and relations with Damascus grow harder.
aussen.anschlag.text.links: The attack comes from within; polarisation grows and the street becomes more suspicious.
aussen.anschlag.text.pkk: The attack hits the peace process: progress falls back, and in northern Iraq pressure on Baghdad and Erbil grows.
aussen.anschlag.titel.is: Attack: the trail leads to IS
aussen.anschlag.titel.links: Attack: the trail leads to a far-left cell
aussen.anschlag.titel.pkk: Attack: the trail leads to a PKK splinter group
aussen.bruch.ende: Broken by the partner: trust and a change of leadership no longer sustained the treaty.
aussen.bruch.text: The other side no longer honours the agreement. It costs standing and shows treaties are only as strong as the trust behind them.
aussen.diaspora.ereignis: An incident in a host country strains relations with the diaspora and its government (historical precedent: {beleg}).
aussen.folge.druck_auf: Pressure on {land} grows, but negotiations get harder
aussen.folge.energie_anteil: More gas from {lieferant}, less dependence on the largest supplier
aussen.folge.energie_keiner: {land} is not an energy supplier: only trust
aussen.folge.eu_hilfe: A year of EU aid: refugee costs halved
aussen.folge.migration_keiner: There is nothing on migration to negotiate with {land}
aussen.folge.rueckkehr_plus: Return to Syria is eased for a year
aussen.folge.westen_skeptisch: Washington and Brussels watch the visit with concern
aussen.folge.zufluss_minus: A quarter fewer arrivals for a year
aussen.frieden.log: The peace process reaches the phase “{phase}”.
aussen.frieden.phase1: First talks begin: cautious, confidential, with many opponents.
aussen.frieden.phase2: A parliamentary commission takes over: the process gains a home and publicity.
aussen.frieden.phase3: The framework law has passed: rights, deadlines and guarantees are on the statute book.
aussen.frieden.phase4: Disarmament proceeds under supervision: every step is counted, every incident exploited.
aussen.frieden.phase5: Return and normalisation: villages are resettled, the region receives investment.
aussen.frieden.zurueck: The process falls back to “{phase}”. Trust built over years vanishes in weeks.
aussen.grund.besuch: A state visit to {land} only makes sense again in {tage} days.
aussen.grund.keine_sanktion: Turkey is currently sanctioning no one.
aussen.grund.ohne_spiel: Without the game loop there is no foreign policy.
aussen.hormus.geschlossen: The Strait of Hormuz is closed: part of the LNG is missing, energy prices rise every month.
aussen.hormus.gestoert: The Strait of Hormuz is disrupted: insurers hesitate, tankers wait, gas gets dearer.
aussen.hormus.offen: The Strait of Hormuz is open again: Gulf LNG flows and prices calm down.
aussen.instr.botschafter_ab.label: Recall ambassador
aussen.instr.botschafter_ab.text: A sharp signal: relations cool, applause at home.
aussen.instr.botschafter_zurueck.label: Send ambassador back
aussen.instr.friedensschritt.ausgang: A new step in the peace process is announced.
aussen.instr.friedensschritt.label: Step in the peace process
aussen.instr.friedensschritt.text: A visible step: meetings, releases, a draft law. Works better when policy stands behind it.
aussen.instr.grenzsicherung.ausgang: The southern border is reinforced for a year.
aussen.instr.grenzsicherung.label: Border security
aussen.instr.grenzsicherung.text: An emergency programme on the southern border for a year: fewer arrivals, less room for IS.
aussen.instr.rueckfuehrung.ausgang: A return programme for Syrians begins.
aussen.instr.rueckfuehrung.label: Return programme
aussen.instr.rueckfuehrung.text: A year of support for voluntary return to Syria: shelter, start-up aid, agreements with Damascus.
aussen.instr.sanktion.label: Impose sanctions
aussen.instr.sanktion.text: Restrict trade to build pressure; your own exporters pay too.
aussen.instr.sanktion_aufheben.label: Lift sanctions
aussen.instr.sanktion_aufheben.text: A sign of détente; trade slowly returns.
aussen.instr.staatsbesuch.label: State visit
aussen.instr.staatsbesuch.text: A visit with a set agenda: trade, security, energy, migration or diaspora.
aussen.sanktion.droht.caatsa: Washington is weighing sanctions on the defence industry. One more month of conflict and they come.
aussen.sanktion.droht.eu_handel: Brussels is preparing trade measures. Without détente or reforms they will soon take effect.
aussen.sanktion.ende: After months of détente the measures are lifted. The damage stays on the books for a while.
aussen.sanktion.text.caatsa: The US imposes sanctions on the defence industry: licences, components and credit become scarce, modernisation stalls.
aussen.sanktion.text.eu_handel: The EU restricts trade and funds: exporters lose orders, capital becomes more cautious.
aussen.termin.nato: NATO summit (date to be confirmed, usually summer)
aussen.termin.ots: Organization of Turkic States summit (autumn, to be confirmed)
aussen.termin.un: UN General Assembly in New York (September)
aussen.ui.diaspora_fluss: Foreign currency from the diaspora: {m} bn dollars a month
aussen.ui.kzt.eu: Basis for accession, visas, customs union
aussen.ui.liste_hinweis: Turkey's position in the world: refugees, energy, security, the peace process, sanctions, the diaspora and the president's instruments.
aussen.ui.verlauf_leer: The history fills up month by month.
aussen.ui.zweck: What the world demands of Turkey and what it gives: the situation over time, instruments with consequences, reports on their effect.
aussen.warn.bruch: Treaty with {land} is shaky: trust is so low the other side could pull out.
aussen.warn.caatsa: The dispute with Washington is nearing the sanctions threshold.
aussen.warn.diaspora: The diaspora is losing trust: savings are flowing out.
aussen.warn.eu: The dispute with Brussels is nearing trade measures.
aussen.warn.flucht: New refugee movement: around {z} thousand people a month are arriving.
aussen.warn.hormus_geschlossen: Hormuz is closed: part of the gas supply is missing.
aussen.warn.hormus_gestoert: Hormuz is disrupted: LNG is becoming dearer and less certain.
aussen.warn.terror_is: The situation in Syria feeds IS: the risk of attacks is high.
aussen.warn.terror_pkk: PKK splinter groups are active: the peace process is at risk.
aussen.warn.winter: Winter will be tight: supply security stands at {v}.
aussen.winter.text: Supply falls short (security {v}): industry is throttled, households freeze, the government loses trust.
aussen.winter.warn: The energy minister warns: with supply security at {v}, gas will not last a cold January. Storage, LNG contracts or a state visit to a supplier would help.
